subject: Returning list of shiny.tag objects from reactiveUI function

messages.author: 2f4550b5cd96ba9e
messages.subject: Returning list of shiny.tag objects from reactiveUI function
parts:
Hi, 

I'm a new Shiny user and just wanted to say how excited I am to see this project in the works. I'm already excited seeing what I can do now and can't wait to see how development progresses in the future. Fantastic work!

On that note, I had a quick question about returning a list of shiny.tag objects from a reactiveUI function. Specifically, according to R package documentation, the function passed to reactiveUI should either return a single shiny.tag object or list of them. In practice, I find that I'm able to make this work when returning a single shiny.tag object but unfortunately not a list and am unsure how to further diagnose the problem. Am I misunderstanding what should be returned or any other suggestions? 

server.R Code looks like:
library(shiny)
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  output$inputs1 <- reactiveUI(function() {
    return(textInput("TextInput1","Text Input 1","Input 1"))  
  })
  
  output$inputs2 <- reactiveUI(function() {
    return( 
        list(textInput("TextInput2","Text Input 2","Input 2"),textInput("TextInput3","Text Input 3","Input 3"))
    )
  })  
})

ui.R code looks like:
shinyUI(bootstrapPage(
  mainPanel(
    uiOutput("inputs1"),
    uiOutput("inputs2")
  )
))

Notably, the uiOutput("inputs1") inputs render correctly but the uiOutput("inputs2") inputs do not. Any idea what I could be doing wrong?

Thank you for any advice!

-Rob

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Returning list of shiny.tag objects from reactiveUI function
parts: Whoops. That is a bug but you can work around it in the meantime by using tagList instead of list.
